limitations.authorship: Questions authored by the same agent that maintains retrieval. Sources and labels frozen before further retrieval edits; no retrieval on these questions before freeze. Not author-blinded.
limitations.exposure: This evaluation consumes final eligibility. These questions are development data after inspection.
limitations.negative: Absent exact-name probes of semantic search; irrelevant locators do not prove fabricated underlying facts.
limitations.sampling: Deliberately authored and correlated questions, not a random or author-blinded sample. Wilson intervals are descriptive.
limitations.scope: Source locator retrieval, not final agent-answer correctness or causal before/after gain.
limitations.tokens: Estimated as ceil(output bytes / 3), measured from complete rendered output.
